alate: 有翅成虫仅少数特征见于记载。单眼与触角窝之间的距离，比单眼自身的直径稍大，二者相比略见宽余。复眼位置偏上，其下缘与头壳下缘之间留有明显间隔，这段距离约为复眼直径的一半。
book_name: 叶额堆砂白蚊 Cryptotermes havilandi
distribution: 国内见于海南崖县与陵水；国外记录于印度、斯里兰卡、非洲、加勒比海沿岸、中美及南美。
en: Only the alate is documented from Chinese material. The space between the ocellus and the antennal socket is somewhat wider than the ocellar diameter, and the eye stands rather high, so that the gap between its lower margin and the underside of the head measures about half the eye diameter. The species is widely distributed in the Old World tropics and has also been reported from the Caribbean, Central America and South America.
